description: This file defines a 'project' repository in Go, handling database operations related to project differentials, including inserting diff rows and retrieving the most recent differential data.

classes.name: project
classes.description: Repository object encapsulating database connection, target metadata, and timestamp generator for project differential operations.

methods.name: InsertDiffRows
methods.description: Inserts multiple differential rows into the project_differential table within a transaction, wrapping errors with context.

methods.name: GetMostRecentOuterKey
methods.description: Retrieves the latest timestamp and UUID for the differential between upstream and downstream targets.

methods.name: GetMostRecentDifferentials
methods.description: Fetches the most recent differential rows for the specified target based on the latest timestamp and UUID.
